author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 6: Greedy + SLSQP Hybrid (v1)
abstract:
This experiment builds on the new Greedy Constructive Heuristic research arc.
The previous experiment showed the greedy method alone produces low-scoring packings.
This version combines the two approaches: the greedy heuristic is used to generate a topologically novel seed, which is then passed to the powerful SLSQP optimizer for refinement.
This tests whether the basin of attraction found by the constructive method is superior to the current SOTA.
